bio1.default: I'm a full-stack developer, AI consultant, and cybersecurity specialist with a long-standing background in web technology and software development. My experience in computer science and web development dates back to 1998, when I co-founded AndersonGraf Technologies in San Antonio, Texas, where we provided IT services and custom web development for local businesses.

bio2.default: Today, I work with SciStories, where I serve as an AI consultant and developer, helping design and build intelligent systems, custom web platforms, and tools that support research labs and scientific communication.

bio3.default: I also collaborate with Librarium Games, consulting on and developing digital versions of tabletop and board games, translating physical gameplay systems into interactive digital experiences.

bio4.default: In addition, I currently work with Worcester Restaurant Group, where I provide software consulting and custom development, helping design tools and digital systems that support training, operations, and internal workflows.

bio5.default: A significant portion of my work involves custom WordPress development, including building themes, plugins, and tailored functionality for complex sites. I regularly develop systems using technologies such as JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PHP, along with AI-assisted tools, automation workflows, and secure infrastructure.

bio6.default: My work often sits at the intersection of web engineering, cybersecurity, and applied AI, allowing me to design platforms that are scalable, maintainable, and secure.

bio7.default: Outside of client work, I contribute to open-source projects and explore emerging technologies including AI systems, developer tooling, and interactive web applications.

bio8.default: I'm currently open to technical consulting and collaborative development projects. If you're building something ambitious and need custom development or AI-driven solutions, I'd be happy to connect.
